summary: Two Bedroom Apartment · South Shields · Available October 2023
description:
My Property Box welcome to the lettings market this two bedroom apartment at The Bridges, South Shields. Situated on the groundfloor, the apartment's modern décor compliments its large living room with patio doors leading to a shared garden. The light and airy interior receives plenty of natural sunlight thanks to large double glazed windows throughout. The property also benefits from a generous galley kitchen and bathroom, as well as two bedrooms.

The location of the apartment suits a tenant who desires quick and easy access to South Shields, A19 motorway and the Tyne Tunnel. Best suited to a single occupant or couple who are looking for a homely, modern apartment.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
